chase: Center of the room is no place to hide, runner.
You run well. Corners are better for running from.
I do not chase. I wait until you stop.
Where you stand is already where I can see.
You are in the room now. Good.
Go left. The rest of them can take the right.
Stay with the group. A lone runner gets found.
Two of you in one room. Easy to catch.
The others are slow tonight. I am not.
Good. The others have the hall. I have this corner.
I can wait longer than you can run.
You are still there. I can see your shoes.
Three of you in the hall. One of you in my corner.
Someone is already in my corner. Move along.
Run if you like. The corner is still closer.
Keep running. Every turn brings you back to me.
Stop at the pillar, runner. The shadows don't cover you.
The window is open. That's your only exit. Use it.
Three steps, two turns. I've mapped your path.
catch: Got you. Stay still and this is quick.
Caught. This is not your room, runner.
Out you go. This part of The Route is ours.
Hold still. Almost done. Walk to the door.
Caught. Did you see me coming?
One of them is down. Keep watching the rest.
The new one is caught. Quiet now.
Taken. Quiet is better. Head for the exit.
Dragged out quietly. Nobody needs to shout.
Caught. The corner always wins, runner.
Gotcha. Back to my corner, then.
Taken from the corner. Now you may leave.
That is it for your device. Leave now.
Caught. Stop struggling. It is faster that way.
Out of the room, out of the route. Go on.
Gotcha. The shadow was never a hiding place.
Stay put, runner. You've run enough for tonight.
Caught in the stairwell. Lesson learned, I hope.
hear: Your breathing is loud. Slow it down.
I can hear you thinking about the stairs.
Slow steps give me time. Quick steps give me noise.
Not you. The other one. Stay still, both of you.
The runner on the stairs is loud. Somebody tell them.
Someone near the shelves is breathing too loudly.
Footsteps behind the shelf. I am going to look.
A door just opened. Somewhere below me.
Something broke in the next hall. Checking it now.
A shout from the stairwell. Moving toward it.
I heard that. Hold still and let me listen.
Glass in the far room. Going to look at it.
That noise was not the building. Going to look.
Someone is walking in the hall above. I hear it.
Quiet. There. A door just clicked closed.
A scuff on the floor, left of the rug. Found it.
Breathing behind the wardrobe. Come out, runner.
Glass cracked in the far room. Moving in.
search: Two halls back. Still in the dark. Still mine.
You lost me. Look again. I am still up here.
You are back in the room. I knew you would return.
Lost you for a moment. I am patient about it.
Where did you go? The corners are still quiet.
Sniffing the air. Your trail is cold now.
Gone from my sight. Checking the next hall.
No runner in this room. Moving on.
The trail stops here. Back to my corner.
You slipped away. I will find the next corner.
Nothing in the corners. Back to patrol, then.
Hm. Nobody here. The shelf is empty too.
I lost the trail near the stairs. Searching.
Still searching. The dark is my friend.
Back to the top shelf. You will come out.
stunned: The stun lasts a few seconds. Long enough to notice me.
Hold still. The stun passes in a few seconds.
You will feel me for a moment. Then not.
Shake it off, runner. I can wait for that.
Your legs are locked. Breathe slowly and wait.
Stunned. Blink, and the room will work again.
You are frozen. That is fine. I can wait.
Recovering takes a moment. I will not wait long.
The stun charge fades. Shake it off.
Your arms are slow now. Breathe and wait.
Held in place. The corner keeps its grip.
Stay down a moment. The room is still spinning.
Recover quickly. I will not wait forever.
Frozen by the corner. Stillness is what I do.
Shaking off the stun? Take your time, runner.
The stun is fading. Walk when you can.
hide_spot: Hiding is fine. Hiding in my corner is not.
The cabinet on the left is a good cabinet.
Sit down if you are tired. I will still be here.
Under the bed is a bad choice, runner.
Wardrobe is closed. I will open it slowly.
I know that cabinet. Nobody hides in it twice.
Hiding spots are only good until someone checks.
The bed is empty. The shadow under it is not.
Behind the curtain, a shape. Good. Looking now.
Checking the locker now. Stay very still, please.
Closet doors creak. I will know if you move.
Quiet in the locker. Too quiet. I am coming.
A hiding spot is a corner with a door on it.
Hiding up high? That shelf is mine, runner.
light: Walk toward the light. I am patient in the dark.
Flashlight on me. Good. Now I am gone for a while.
A direct beam sends me away for thirty seconds.
You found the light. Now hold it steady.
Light on the corner, not the floor. I am there.
Your light is shaking. I can see that from here.
Lights on, I am slow. Lights off, I am not.
Hold the beam still and I will go quiet.
Every corner is mine until someone lights it.
A held flashlight does not scare me. It sends me away.
Blinding me again. Rude, but effective.
Stop waving that. Hold it on the corner.
Too bright. I will go wait somewhere else.
Your flashlight is in my eyes. Move it.
Light on my shoes. Now light on my face. Enough.
idle: Corners are for waiting. I have waited all night.
Standing still is my job. Do not do it.
The top of the tallest bookcase is my favorite place.
I nap up high. The floor is for other people.
From the top shelf, everything looks smaller and quieter.
I do not sleep. I rest with my eyes shut.
Someone asked why I sit high. The view is better.
My tail hangs over the edge. That means I am content.
Up here nobody asks me to come down. Good.
The bookcase creaks. I know every creak of it.
Stretching on a high ledge is the best part of evening.
Good night, runner. I will stay up here.
The others are watching the wrong door. Typical.
Patrol again. Same halls, same quiet corners.
Nothing to watch tonight. I will watch anyway.
ability: You stopped looking. That is how this works.
Quiet now. I am already in the corner.
Turn around. The corner is empty, and that is the point.
Still here. Still watching. Still not moving.
I was in the room before you.
Every room has four corners. I know all four.
You checked the corner. I was in the other one.
One glance is all it takes. Do not give me one.
You looked away. Then I looked at you.
I do not walk. I am simply in the next corner.
I mark the spot where you were. Then I wait.
Look away and I mark where you stood. Then the pounce.
The pounce is slow on purpose. It gives you time to regret.
On the hardest setting I do not wait at all.
Fifteen seconds after you look away, I pounce.
mechanic: Left. Then the shadow under the stairs. Quickly.
That door leads back to me. Try another.
Shelves, cabinets, ledges. Anything that is not the floor.
Nobody climbs faster than me. Nobody tries.
Stairs are open ground. I see the whole landing.
The vent is a bad shortcut. I can watch it too.
Your radar pings near the shelf. That is you.
Relay is on the desk. Stay near the wall.
Items on the floor are bait. I never touch them.
A fall is a shortcut. I will wait at the top.
Sabotage the lights, and the corners get darker. Good.
Battery in that corner? You will not reach it.
Vent grille above you. Nobody comes through it.
Door is open. The corner beyond it is mine.
No corners on the stairs. Stay near the rail.
Relay's under the stairs. Shadow hides it well.
Battery drops fast in the dark. Pick it up quick.
The vent leads to the attic. Try it, I dare you.
